description: Machine-readable feature ownership map. Each feature names the paths it owns, the tests and entrypoints that guard it, and its docs. An agent assigned to a feature works inside its paths; anything else is an expansion request.

features.name: core-simulation
features.summary: The pure deterministic simulation: content DTOs, price model, day tick, crew, standing, city stats, events, contracts, expos, warehouses, mining, AI policies.
invariants: Core purity (no I/O, no clock, no unseeded randomness)
seed + commands = identical state
content lives in data/, never in C#

features.name: commands-and-state
features.summary: The command boundary: command records, the single state-changing processor, and command validation semantics.
invariants: state changes only through CommandProcessor
rejected commands leave state untouched
F_state/F_view pins and save fixtures must stay byte-stable

features.name: world-and-content
features.summary: Loading data/ into a validated WorldData: terrain painting, route graph, city profiles, and the generated map world.
invariants: every data/ JSON referenced by the loader stays listed in MinimalWorld.Files
world.js is generated only by make-world.js and pinned by tools/verify-worldjs.ps1

features.name: view-layer
features.summary: State-to-display snapshots: view models and ViewBuilder, the wire contract consumed by both front-ends.
invariants: the frontend never computes a rule; derive it in ViewBuilder and put it on a view model
API fixture baselines (except build.json dynamic metadata) are byte-stable

features.name: host-api
features.summary: The thin ASP.NET adapter: five endpoints, static file serving, the running game session, build info.
invariants: no rule lives in the host
port 5080 must be released after every verification run

features.name: frontend-chart
features.summary: The player view served at /chart/: Keeper's Chart, game bridge, ops shell pages/tabs, tile worker, generated world.
invariants: the shell never computes a rule
bump ?v=N in chart.html on any script you change
web/archive/ is dead code; do not revive it
world.js bytes are generated, not hand-edited

features.name: balance-harness
features.summary: The headless economy gate and FIGURES.md generator: bot policies, budgets, and the published figures.
invariants: FIGURES.md is generated; timing-line-only diffs are restored, never committed
skill must beat luck; the tick budget in the harness is authoritative

features.name: verification-and-fixtures
features.summary: Everything that proves the product: the nine-gate acceptance suite, Fast/feature/Full entrypoints, determinism fixtures, API baselines, browser smoke, clean-clone proof.
invariants: Fast and feature checks never certify a green state
the existing nine check.ps1 gates may be added to but never weakened
F_state/F_view pins are immutable without an explicit re-baseline decision

features.name: launcher-and-build
features.summary: Launching, the desktop shortcut, the version string, and the solution layout.
invariants: VERSION is the one place the version string is set; the build page and acceptance gate 7 read it
the launcher rebuilds before serving so it cannot start a stale build

features.name: agent-docs-and-process
features.summary: AI-facing context and coordination records: canonical instructions, ownership map, codemap, feature notes, glossary, ADRs, and the migration control documents.
invariants: docs/codemap.md is generated; regenerate, never hand-edit
the ledger is single-writer (coordinator only)
chat is notification, not a source of truth
